name: NusaX-MT — Indonesian local languages multi-parallel (test)
description: NusaX-MT — the held-out test split (400 rows) of the 12-way multi-parallel Indonesian benchmark: Indonesian ↔ 10 local languages (Acehnese, Balinese, Banjar, Buginese, Javanese, Madurese, Minangkabau, Ngaju, Sundanese, Batak Toba) + English, expert-translated from the NusaX sentiment corpus (social-media/review register). Ind-hub scope here (22 directed pairs); the CSV is genuinely 12-way parallel so more pairs are a recipe extension. Fetched on demand from the IndoNLP repo at a pinned commit; Champollion never hosts the content. Domain: conv. Contamination HIGH — public since 2022, in frontier-model crawls — so scores are relative-comparison-only. DATA license CC BY-SA 4.0 (verified at the pin: datasets/LICENSE; code is Apache-2.0) — commercial-compatible with share-alike; cleared by the license review of 2026-08-24: benchmarkable, commercial-compatible (attribution + share-alike).

segments.name: NusaX-MT test
segments.purpose: MT evaluation — held-out benchmark test split (relative-comparison-only)

download.instructions: Single multi-parallel file datasets/mt/test.csv fetched from the pinned commit (immutable); pairing.mode csv-columns selects each side's column by header name. Both directions scored per pair.

source.citation: Winata et al. (2023). NusaX: Multilingual Parallel Sentiment Dataset for 10 Indonesian Local Languages. EACL 2023.

license.aiTraining: Held-out benchmark test split; not intended for training. doNotTrain protects benchmark integrity.
license.notes: Verified at the pinned commit: datasets/LICENSE is CC BY-SA 4.0 (covers the data); the root and code/ LICENSE files are Apache-2.0 (cover the code). CC BY-SA permits commercial use with attribution + share-alike — flagged commercial=true, and the license review of 2026-08-24 confirms the lane. Champollion never hosts the content (fetch-from-source).

usageRestrictions.communityNotes: Held-out benchmark: training on it defeats its purpose. CC BY-SA 4.0 data license is commercial-compatible (attribution + share-alike) — cleared by the license review of 2026-08-24 beyond the NC lane. Content is fetched from source, never hosted.

contamination.reasoning: NusaX test split — public since 2022 and in frontier-model training crawls. Scores are valid only for relative method-vs-method comparison on this exact corpus, never as absolute quality. Forced HIGH here and via build_registry.HELD_OUT_BENCHMARK_FAMILIES.

licenseReview.basis: DATA license CC BY-SA 4.0, stated and verified at the pinned revision (datasets/LICENSE; root + code/ LICENSE are Apache-2.0 and cover the code). Attribution + share-alike; benchmarkable in all lanes. doNotTrain stands for benchmark integrity, not license.
